title: Check Divisibility by Digit Sum and Product
summary: Given a positive integer n, check if it is divisible by the sum of its digit sum and digit product.
statement: Given a positive integer n, check if it is divisible by the sum of its digit sum and digit product. Return true if divisible, otherwise false.
constraints: Compute the sum and product of the decimal digits of positive n.
Return whether n is divisible by that combined value.
reference_solution:
def is_divisible_by_digit_sum_and_product(n):
    digits=[int(c) for c in str(n)];product=1
    for digit in digits:product*=digit
    return n%(sum(digits)+product)==0
known_wrong_solutions:

    return n%(sum(digits)+product+1)==0
def is_divisible_by_digit_sum_and_product(n):
    digits=[int(c) for c in str(n)];product=1
    for digit in digits:product*=digit
    return n%(sum(digits)+product)!=0
hints: Take n modulo the sum of those aggregates.
A zero remainder is exactly divisibility.
editorial: A zero remainder is exactly divisibility.
